notes: *which* is added: the Hebrew sets מַעֲשֵׂה in apposition with no relative morpheme, so rules 46 and 55 leave the supplied subordinator unlicensed, while the copula goes to the nominal predicate under rule 20.
The article on אָדָם is unrepresented beside the English possessive *men's*, the phrase's one *the* standing before the outer construct (rule 29).
